verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an issue-tracking and monitoring platform, but nothing in the evidence documents acting on many items at once, such as bulk-resolving, bulk-assigning or bulk-ignoring issues via the UI, API or MCP. The closest items are generic API resource management, multi-project dashboard viewing and per-issue Autofix triage. These are adjacent features, not a documented bulk-action capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
